title: Chapter 1299 - 43: My Turn
content:
Chapter 1299 - 43: My Turn

Chapter 1299: Chapter 43: My Turn

Secret World.

The sect masters and many high-level members of the sects looked at Lin Yuan with slight astonishment.

Is there a way to deal with the Demon God?

The Demon God possesses the battle power of a thirteenth-tier Eternal Lord.

Only an Eternal Lord of the same level can confront the Demon God.

Even now, as the Secret World withstands the Demon God’s frenzied attacks.

Fundamentally, it’s by relying on the arrangements left by an Eternal Lord.

Essentially, it is still the Eternal Lord and the Demon God engaged in a confrontation.

And such resistance is not true confrontation.

Solely relying on the arrangements left by the Eternal Lord can only temporarily delay.

Once the resources sustaining the operation of the many Eternal Treasures are exhausted.

The consequences are obvious.

But Lin Yuan says there is another way to deal with the Demon God?

"Lord Galaxy, please tell us, what should we do?"

The sect masters only hesitated for a moment, then chose to trust Lin Yuan.

Over the millennia, Lin Yuan’s many actions had earned the trust of the sect masters.

"Give me all the foundational resources that drive the Eternal Treasures," Lin Yuan said.

Now, the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World he has been developing is already 99% complete.

The remaining tenth of a percent, it’s difficult to surpass in a short time.

After all, in this Fang Yuan World, all the ’demons’ with a bit of strength have been hunted by Lin Yuan.

This is also the key reason for the Demon God’s fury upon descending.

As for absorbing and devouring Demonic Qi?

The efficiency is too slow.

And now the Demon God has already descended.

With a single thought controlling vast Demonic Qi, Lin Yuan can’t manage to absorb and devour.

And now Lin Yuan is trapped in the Secret World, outside is the Demon God.

Even in the worst case, spending hundreds or thousands of years to finish the last tenth of a percent, it’s likely very hard to do.

Given Lin Yuan’s strength, if he dares to step out of the Secret World.

He will inevitably become the Demon God’s primary target of attack.

There is simply no time to continue hunting other ’demons.’

...

Thinking it over.

The hope for Lin Yuan to completely develop his Infinite Constant Sand Particle World.

Can only be placed on the foundational resources of the major Eternal Sects.

Rather than consuming these resources in the Demon God’s incessant assaults.

It’s better to give them all to Lin Yuan, allowing him to complete the development of the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World.

Once the Particle World is successful, Lin Yuan’s strength will soar, with full prospects of directly confronting the Demon God.

This could also prevent the Secret World from being breached.

This is also currently the most advantageous method Lin Yuan can think of for himself and the major Eternal Sects.

Judging by the Demon God’s current means of attack outside.

Lin Yuan is confident that once his Particle World is successful, he can face the Demon God head-on.

"Lord Galaxy wants all the foundational resources?" The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect was startled.

The other sect masters also wore serious expressions.

These foundational resources are currently their hope of resisting the Demon God.

Even though they would be exhausted in millions or even tens of millions of years, they can hold on for that long.

At least they can grant enough time for the elite of the major Eternal Sects to retreat.

And give them all to Lin Yuan?

If Lin Yuan can’t hold off the Demon God.

The breach of the Secret World would occur in the blink of an eye.

"That’s right."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Actually, to complete the last tenth of a percent, aside from the current foundational resources of the Eternal Sect.

There are other ways.

For example, utilizing the Myriad Realms Gate to transport resources over.

Providing resources from start to finish for Lin Yuan to develop the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World.

The cost is too great for Lin Yuan to bear.

But just for the last tenth of a percent.

Lin Yuan can grit his teeth and accept it.

But concerning the World-Breaking Origin Force, it must be saved if possible.

"Lord Galaxy... are you confident?"

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect asked cautiously.

"There should be no problem,"

Lin Yuan glanced at the Demon God outside.

If the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World is fully developed, with the strength at that time, blocking the Demon God should not be any problem.

The other sect masters exchanged glances.

This Secret World was arranged by the many Eternal Lords.

With the methods of the Eternal Lords, they couldn’t withstand the Demon God’s millions or tens of millions of years of attacks.

Yet Lin Yuan says there’s no problem?

"If that is the case, these six Eternal Sources are entrusted to Lord Galaxy."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect’s expression fluctuated, but he finally spoke seriously.

The sect masters behind him wanted to speak but stopped, ultimately saying nothing.

For the Eternal Sect, whether supporting for millions or tens of millions of years or for ten and eight years, the difference is not significant.

Rather than watching the Secret World be trampled by the Demon God, it’s better to place their hopes on Lin Yuan.

After all, the current situation has already surpassed the predictions of many Eternal Lords before the great change of Heaven and Earth.

No Eternal Lord foresaw a future timeline that included the present situation.

Therefore, the sect masters are also confused, not knowing how to respond.

Swoosh!

An inexplicable fluctuation emerged in the Secret World.

Immediately, six Eternal Sources, like suns, emerged from the deepest part of the Secret World.

It was precisely these six Eternal Sources that supported the operation of multiple defensive Eternal Treasures, blocking the Demon God’s repeated attacks from outside.

Lin Yuan watched the six Eternal Sources emanating a vast aura of fluctuations.

The Eternal Source, condensed by the power of an Eternal Lord, can fully activate the power of an Eternal Treasure.

"I only need five," Lin Yuan did not hesitate; every time the Demon God attacks, the energy within the six Eternal Sources decreases.

According to Lin Yuan’s estimate, four Eternal Sources would be enough for him to finish the last tenth of a percent progress.

The reason for requesting an extra one was to ensure absolute safety.

"Mm."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect nodded.
